summary: Palm Tree Fire reported catching a two-story apartment complex with the roof involved. Alarm reinforced — Engine 7 established as incident command, scene access off Villalobos. Dispatcher flagged it as the night's primary incident.
Report of a vehicle on fire and involved in a collision; location not announced on the air.
Person refusing to leave an H&R Block business near Sanford and Roberts; business requesting video surveillance.
Silver Acura sedan with no tail light reported at high speed, southbound Highway 99 near Panama Lane, with a CHP unit in chase.
Attempt to locate for a welfare check on a 66-year-old male.
Patrol check for an unknown male knocking at a door — also wanting to report fireworks — upgraded to a possible shooting; units staging.
Reported domestic assault — a man allegedly assaulted his wife, who was reportedly in the vehicle with him; units responding.
Residents reporting damage to their front fence.
White GMC parked in an odd manner; suspicious-vehicle check.
Vehicle checks on a Honda reported out of Ukiah and a Ford; plate reads broadcast on the air.
Welfare check on a 59-year-old female; her son reportedly involved.
